purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only routes without querying personal/property attributes.
primaryPublisher: Abia State Ministry of Lands, Survey & Urban Planning / Zonal Land Office, Umuahia
registryBasis: An Abia State Ministry process document locates a Zonal Land Office in Umuahia and states it processes Certificates of Occupancy, title confirmation through the Deeds Registry/ABIAGIS, survey charting and inspection. The state property portal documents land-title/registration workflows requiring applicant identity and supporting property documents. This confirms a local Umuahia office and record service, not open parcel geometry or citywide coverage.
